title.en: Supervised fine-tuning on a small dataset

summary.en: Supervised fine-tuning on facts the base model cannot know, then the same questions asked to the base model and to the trained weights.
summary.zh: 使用基座模型不可能知道的虚构事实进行监督微调，再用同一组问题对比基座模型与训练后模型的回答。

you_will_see.0.en: The whole loop is two API calls per step, made by a for-loop in your process
you_will_see.0.zh: 训练循环在本地进程中执行，每步调用两次 API

you_will_see.1.en: Session from request to Running in about 10 s, loss falling over 8 steps
you_will_see.1.zh: session 从发起请求到 Running 约需 10 s，展示 8 步训练中的 loss 下降情况

you_will_see.2.en: Ask the model a question mid-run: it answers from a snapshot of the weights at that step
you_will_see.2.zh: 运行期间可向模型提问，模型使用当前步骤的权重快照作答

evidence.note.en: Live on 2026-10-29: ready in 10.8 s, loss 7.99 to 0.03 by step 6, and 7 of 8 questions answered with the trained fact. The first forward_backward took 52 s, the others about 4 s. BillableTokenUsage matched the estimate.
evidence.note.zh: 2026-10-29 实时运行：session 在 10.8 s 后就绪，loss 从 7.99 降至第 6 步的 0.03；8 个问题中，7 个回答包含训练中的事实。首次 forward_backward 耗时 52 s，之后每次约 4 s。BillableTokenUsage 与估算一致。

node.forward_backward.out.zh: 梯度保存在 GPU 上

slot.data.facts.summary.en: Question and answer pairs the base model cannot know.
slot.data.facts.summary.zh: 包含基座模型不可能知道的事实的问答对。

slot.data.facts.watch.en: Edit them: the batch is built from this list in your process.
slot.data.facts.watch.zh: 训练数据可编辑，本地进程根据列表构建 batch。

param.save_checkpoint.label.zh: 保存可恢复训练的 checkpoint

param.save_checkpoint.help.en: save_state took 53 s when measured; it writes weights + optimizer state to a CHECKPOINT package.
param.save_checkpoint.help.zh: 实测 save_state 耗时 53 s，会将权重和优化器状态保存为 CHECKPOINT 包。

events.Probes use max_tokens=512, the service m: 提问时使用 max_tokens=512，即服务允许的最小值，并在首个换行处结束生成，以保持回答简短。低于此值的请求无法通过校验。
events.Same questions, base model vs trained we: 同一组问题：对比基座模型与训练后模型
events.Questions answered with the trained fact: 回答包含训练事实的问题数
